The Nooir Klavier II is a mechanical keyboard with a CNC aluminum case, suspended internal structure, adjustable typing feel, and a price tag that reaches $1,350 USD with switches and keycaps. Plouffe builds it, tests it, and tries to figure out whether this is a keyboard, a desk sculpture, or both.
